propositions: Extract build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend out of PydanticAIRunner.run() into a new leaf module src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py as plain functions with explicit parameters.
The extraction is a pure relocation with no changed public signatures, no altered logic, and no existing test edited, weakened, or skipped.
web_caps and _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site stay in runner.py so no monkeypatch targets are repointed by the change.
log_call_success and record_call_spend must remain separate functions because record_call_spend stays on the far side of finalize_outcome to preserve the success-log-on-finalization-failure behavior.
The now-unused infer_provider import is dropped from runner.py and moves with record_call_spend.
runner.py had only one line of headroom under the 700-LOC seam assertion, but the authoritative module cap is 800 and mechanical splitting to hit a number is forbidden.
